summary: Markets opened mixed on Tuesday as investors braced for Nvidia's highly anticipated earnings report Wednesday and weighed escalating geopolitical tensions. The S&P 500 fell 0.28% Monday to 7,652.86, while the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.76% as semiconductor stocks led declines, with Micron down 5.8% and the SOXX chip ETF sliding 2.7%. Treasury yields eased after reports the Treasury may use its general account to fund bond buybacks. Meanwhile, Bitcoin surged to near $80,000, gaining roughly 28% in August 2026, driven by Treasury buyback optimism, a massive short squeeze that liquidated over $600 million in positions, and renewed political momentum for pro-crypto legislation. Futures pointed to a modest rebound Tuesday morning, with S&P 500 futures up 0.12% and Nasdaq 100 futures climbing 0.37%. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent unveiled expanded sanctions on Iran, adding geopolitical risk to the mix as traders await critical housing and consumer data alongside the Nvidia earnings event.

signals.title: Bitcoin rallies 28% in August on Treasury buyback plan and short squeeze
signals.desc: Bitcoin surged to $80,523 after Treasury bond buyback announcements triggered a massive short liquidation wave and renewed institutional flows into spot Bitcoin ETFs.

signals.title: Chip stocks tumble as semiconductor weakness weighs on tech sector
signals.desc: Micron fell 5.8% and the SOXX semiconductor ETF dropped 2.7% Monday, dragging the Nasdaq down 0.76% ahead of Nvidia's critical earnings report Wednesday.

signals.title: Treasury bond buyback plan pressures yields, supports risk assets
signals.desc: Reports that Treasury may use its $1 trillion general account for buybacks pushed yields lower and helped markets cut early losses Monday.

signals.title: U.S. expands Iran sanctions, raising Middle East geopolitical risk
signals.desc: Treasury Secretary Bessent's expanded sanctions on Iran add uncertainty to energy markets and risk appetite as traders await oil price reaction.

signals.title: Nvidia earnings Wednesday could spark AI trade resurgence
signals.desc: Markets positioned for potential volatility around Nvidia's Wednesday earnings, with options pricing significant implied moves as AI trade sentiment hangs in balance.

verdict: Markets face a critical inflection point with Nvidia earnings Wednesday amid chip weakness, Treasury buyback optimism, and Iran sanctions uncertainty.
